# Assert page remains on project creation form

instruction: Sort project list alphabetically
input: URL: https://taskflow-client-test.vercel.app/projects DOM Structure: Beta Project Alpha Project Test Intent: Verify projects are sorted alphabetically after clicking sort button
output:
page.locator('#sort-alpha-btn').click()
page.wait_for_timeout(500)

titles = page.locator('.project-title')
names = [titles.nth(i).text_content().strip() for i in range(titles.count())]

assert names == sorted(names), f'Projects not sorted alphabetically: {names}'

instruction: Add subtask to main task
input:
URL: https://taskflow-client-test.vercel.app/tasks/task-60 DOM Structure:
Subtask 1
Test Intent: Verify new subtask is rendered under task details
output:
page.locator('#subtask-input').fill('Subtask 1')
page.locator('#add-subtask-btn').click()

try:
    subtask = page.get_by_text('Subtask 1')
    subtask.wait_for(timeout=5000)
    assert subtask.is_visible()
except Exception as e:
    console_errors.append(f'Subtask creation failed: {e}')
    raise

instruction: Batch delete multiple tasks via checkbox selection
input:
URL: https://taskflow-client-test.vercel.app/tasks DOM Structure:
Task 1
Test Intent: Verify selected tasks are removed following batch deletion
output:
checkboxes = page.locator('.select-task-checkbox')
for i in range(checkboxes.count()):
    checkboxes.nth(i).check()

page.locator('#bulk-delete-btn').click()
page.wait_for_timeout(1000)

remaining = page.locator('.task-item').count()
assert remaining == 0, f'Tasks remain after batch delete: count {remaining}'
